summary: Matchmaking, jealousy and gossip read in character and trade honestly; romance cards gate on partner, ex and suitor roles. Two small fixes, both made: a verb that didn't follow {they}, and a lake picnic that could come up in snow.

issues.problem: "{they} look{s} pleased anyway, and stands a little taller": 'stands' doesn't follow a they/them pronoun.
The third variant (a picnic by the lake) can be dealt in any season, snow included.
issues.fix: Move it indoors: a window seat saved for two, with the cushion for you; scene to match.
